import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static Map<BitSet, Integer> id = new HashMap<>();
    static int N, cnt;
    static int[][] P = new int[7][7];
    static long[][] dp = new long[2][70003];
    static int[][] trans = new int[70003][128];
    static long[] prob = new long[128];
    static long iv100;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        N = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine().trim());
        BitSet tmp = new BitSet(N);
        tmp.set(0);
        dfs(tmp);
        iv100 = poww(100, MOD - 2);
        System.out.println(id.size());

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            String[] line = br.readLine().trim().split("\\s+");
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                P[i][j] = Integer.parseInt(line[j]);
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << N); i++) {
            tmp.set(i);
        }

        dp[0][1] = 1;
        int x = 0;

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << N); j++) {
                prob[j] = 1;
                for (int k = 0; k < N; k++) {
                    long val = prob[j] * iv100 % MOD;
                    if (((j >> k) & 1) == 1) {
                        val = val * P[i][k] % MOD;
                    } else {
                        val = val * (100 - P[i][k]) % MOD;
                    }
                    prob[j] = val;
                }
            }
            Arrays.fill(dp[x ^ 1], 0);
            for (int j = 1; j <= cnt; j++) {
                if (dp[x ^ 1][j] != 0) {
                    for (int k = 0; k < (1 << N); k++) {
                        int t = trans[j][k];
                        dp[x][t] = (dp[x][t] + dp[x ^ 1][j] * prob[k]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            x ^= 1;
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << N); i++) {
            tmp.set(i);
        }
        System.out.println(dp[x][id.get(tmp)]);
    }

    static int poww(long a, int b) {
        long res = 1;
        long base = a % MOD;
        while (b > 0) {
            if ((b & 1) == 1) {
                res = res * base % MOD;
            }
            base = base * base % MOD;
            b >>= 1;
        }
        return (int) res;
    }

    static int dfs(BitSet x) {
        if (id.containsKey(x))
            return id.get(x);
        int nd = ++cnt;
        id.put((BitSet) x.clone(), nd);
        BitSet[] tmpSets = new BitSet[N];
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            tmpSets[i] = new BitSet(1 << N);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j < (1 << N); j++) {
                if (((j >> i) & 1) == 1) {
                    tmpSets[i].set(j | (1 << i));
                } else {
                    tmpSets[i].set(j);
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << N); i++) {
            BitSet tp = (BitSet) x.clone();
            for (int j = 0; j < N; j++) {
                if (((i >> j) & 1) == 1) {
                    tp.or(tmpSets[j]);
                }
            }
            trans[nd][i] = dfs(tp);
        }
        return nd;
    }
}
